legacy_namespace_note: The branch field and parallel_* filenames are compatibility identifiers. Canonical integration authority is main.
purpose: Concurrency-safe coordination for short-lived feature tasks based on canonical main without global branch/lease scanning in the hot path.

task_record_enforcement.legacy_policy: Feature branches based before the enforcement marker are grandfathered; newer feature branches own exactly one task record.

lease_policy.conflict_resolution: Leases are optional diagnostic metadata only. Normal preflight/integration does not require a lease.
lease_policy.legacy_policy: Existing lease records remain readable for diagnostics; no lease is required on the normal hot path.

reconciler.branch_cleanup_policy: Persistent cleanup deletes only proven integrated feature refs; global reconciliation is not a hot-path prerequisite.

auto_integration.profile_gate_policy: Profile-routed file changes declare matching delivery_profiles. Required profiles pass on the exact feature SHA and exact integrated delivery SHA.

diagnostic_hotfix_fast_path.fallback: Any ambiguity, extra path, unsupported module/profile or forbidden token falls back to STANDARD.

rules: New ordinary tasks branch from current canonical main, not from work or an independent parallel world.
Each feature owns one runtime/parallel_tasks/<task-id>.json coordination record.
Independent coding and targeted preflight run concurrently; only canonical integration is serialized.
shared_resources signal ordered integration/arbitration when they overlap.
Global lease election/reconciliation is not required for normal preflight or integration.
delivery_profiles are fail-closed declarations for profile-routed paths.
auto_integrate is explicit and requires ready_for_integration plus resolved declared dependencies.
The queue revalidates against current main immediately before merge.
The queue atomically advances main and parallel to one integrated SHA without force.
Post-integration delivery is selected by the path/risk router; unknown or mixed runtime changes require STANDARD.
Successful exact-SHA delivery precedes feature branch cleanup.
Task metadata never replaces exact-SHA CI, provenance, package or gameplay evidence.
